PANEL.TITLE: Give read-only access to your AWS account
PANEL.INTRO: You create a role that can only read your account's configuration. You don't share passwords or keys, and you can delete the role whenever you want.
PANEL.PASTE_VALUES: When AWS asks for the parameters, paste these two values:
PANEL.MISSING_PRINCIPAL: Monkey doesn't have the identity that assumes the role configured yet. Let us know before continuing.
PANEL.ROLE_HELP: It's the “RoleArn” value in the Outputs tab of the stack in AWS.

FORM.TITLE: Your account details
FORM.READ_ONLY_NOTE: Monkey only reads, it never changes anything. What you share (keys or passwords, if your connection asks for them) is stored encrypted and is not shown again.
FORM.NAME_HINT: Give it a name so you can recognize it later.
FORM.METHOD_LABEL: How do you want to connect your {{name}} account?
FORM.METHOD_ROLE_HELP: You don't share any password or key: you create a role in your account that can only read, and you tell us which one it is.
FORM.METHOD_KEYS_HELP: You paste a read-only access key. It lasts a long time, so it is less secure than a role.
FORM.ACCOUNT_HELP: It's 12 digits. You see it at the top right of the AWS console, when you open your user menu.
FORM.ACCOUNT_HINT: Enter the 12 digits of the account.
FORM.REGIONS_LABEL: In which regions do you have resources?
FORM.REGIONS_HELP: We will only look at the regions you choose. You can select several.
FORM.KEYS_NOTE: Use an IAM user that only has the SecurityAudit and ViewOnlyAccess policies. The key is stored encrypted and is not shown again.
FORM.IMPORTANCE: How important is it for your service?
FORM.ALSO_SUPPORTS: Does it also support other services?
FORM.ALSO_SUPPORTS_HELP: This way you don't register it twice. It's optional.
FORM.CHECK_MARKED: Check the marked fields and try again.
FORM.METHOD_NOT_APPLICABLE: That connection type isn't available for this platform. Choose another one.
FORM.REGISTER_ERROR: We couldn't register the asset. Please try again.

SERVER_FORM.TITLE: Your server's details
SERVER_FORM.NOTE: Here you only tell us your server's name and which system it runs. We don't ask for passwords or keys: in the next step we give you a command with this server's key, shown only once.
SERVER_FORM.VERSION_LABEL: Which version of {{name}} does it run?
SERVER_FORM.VERSION_HELP: With the version we build the right command for your server and know what to check on it.
SERVER_FORM.VERSIONS_ERROR: We couldn't load the available versions. Check your connection and try again.
SERVER_FORM.REGISTER_ERROR: We couldn't register the server. Try again.

AGENT.TITLE: Install the Monkey probe on this server
AGENT.INTRO: The probe is a lightweight program that reads your server's configuration ({{version}}) and sends it to Monkey to be assessed. It only reads: it changes nothing.
AGENT.BEFORE_ADMIN_LINUX: Sign in to the server as an administrator: as root, or as a user who can use sudo.
AGENT.BEFORE_ADMIN_WINDOWS: Sign in to the server as an administrator and open PowerShell with “Run as administrator”.
AGENT.BEFORE_OUTBOUND: The server must be able to connect to {{host}} on port {{port}} (outbound connection). You don't need to open any inbound port.
AGENT.START_HELP: When you're ready, we prepare this server's key. It takes a few seconds.
AGENT.PREPARING: We're preparing this server's key. A few seconds…
AGENT.READY_WARNING: All set. When you show the command you'll see this server's key, and it's shown only once: have the server where you'll paste it at hand.
AGENT.ONCE_WARNING: Copy it now. It contains this server's key and we won't show it again. If you lose it, generate a new one.
AGENT.OR_FILE: Or download the file and run it in {{shell}}:
AGENT.WAITING: Waiting for the server to connect. It can take a couple of minutes after you run the command.
AGENT.ALREADY_SHOWN: The command was already shown and can't be seen again.
AGENT.CONNECTED: The server is connected. Monkey can now receive its information.
AGENT.REGENERATE: Didn't get to copy it? Generate a new command
AGENT.REGENERATE_CONFIRM: A new key is created and the previous one stops working. If you already ran the previous command on the server, you'll need to run the new one.
AGENT.NOT_READY: The command was already shown or has expired. Generate a new one to continue.
AGENT.UNAVAILABLE: This Monkey installation isn't ready to connect servers yet. Let your Monkey contact know.
AGENT.IN_PROGRESS: We're already preparing this server's key. Wait a few seconds.
AGENT.WAITING_AUTO: We look for it on our own every few minutes: you don't need to do anything else. When it connects, this status changes by itself.
AGENT.CHECK_IN_PROGRESS: We're already checking this server. You'll see the result in a moment.
AGENT.CHECK_FAILED: We couldn't check the server. Try again in a few minutes.
AGENT.CHECK_SLOW: The check is still running. Look again in a few minutes: if the server connects, this status changes by itself.
AGENT.EXPIRED: We didn't see the server connect in the last 24 hours. Check that the command ran without errors and that the server can reach {{host}}:{{port}}. If you're not sure, generate a new command.
AGENT.DISCONNECTED: The server stopped reporting to Monkey. Check that it is on and that it can reach {{host}}:{{port}}. When it's back, it connects by itself.
AGENT.ERROR: We couldn't complete this step. Try again.
